title: CAS Test Plan Manifest
description: Inventory of test specification files, their coverage targets, and implementation status. Follows the pattern of docs/fs/manifest.json.

tiers.1: Contract tests: schema validation and API contract shape verification, mechanically derived from the formal substrate.
tiers.2: Behavioral tests: semantic rules, error paths, lifecycle logic, policy enforcement. Requires design decisions.
tiers.3: Domain integration tests: end-to-end validation with Example Portfolio configs and representative workflows.

test_specs.title: Cross-Cutting Boundary Tests
test_specs.notes: 6 fully specified from SAGE decisions, 3 stubs awaiting ROOT Harness tier 2 decisions, 3 error semantics stubs

test_specs.title: SAGE Adapter Tests
test_specs.notes: nomic-embed-text EmbeddingProvider (8 tests, AD-001..AD-008), LanceDB ContentStore (RETIRED with the embedded storage backend, CAS-ADR-042; was 17 tests, AD-009..AD-025 -- Postgres content-store coverage lives in tests/sage/test_content_store_postgres.py), Qwen3 AbstractionProvider (8 tests, AD-026..AD-033), Markdown adapter provenance (1 test, AD-034), Docx source adapter (18 tests, AD-035..AD-052), Xlsx source adapter (15 tests, AD-053..AD-067), Word template .dotx adapter (8 tests, AD-068..AD-075), PDF source adapter v0.1 native-text only (19 tests, AD-076..AD-094), Qwen3 lazy loading (3 tests, AD-095..AD-097, relocated from AD-035..AD-037 in v0.9.15), LanceDB has_chunks existence check (RETIRED with the embedded storage backend; was 2 tests, AD-098..AD-099, renumbered from AD-068..AD-069 in v0.9.16 to resolve cross-class collision with dotx specs -- the has_chunks contract is covered against Postgres by test_has_chunks in tests/sage/test_content_store_postgres.py). Numbering is contiguous AD-001..AD-099 with two retired ranges; test_count reflects only active specs.

test_specs.title: CAS Application Frontend Tests
test_specs.notes: UI behavior tests for all 6 views: Dashboard (6 tests), Ingest (11 tests), Metadata Review (5 tests), Edge Review (6 tests), Search (5 tests), Document Detail (6 tests), Graph Explorer (13 tests), Navigation/vault selector (3 tests).

test_specs.title: CAS Application Backend Tests
test_specs.notes: New SAGE API endpoints (vault listing 2, vault statistics 4, hash-check 3, staging edges 4, pending metadata 2, pipeline status filter 1) and application backend endpoints (scan 5, batch ingest via SSE 7, edge inference integration 3, conventions 2). BE-018 revised for parsed metadata in scan results. BE-025 revised for metadata dict in ingest calls. BE-029/030 renumbered to BE-034/035. BE-036 added for document_date in pending metadata extracted_fields. ID range BE-001..BE-036 with a 029/030 gap from the renumbering.

test_specs.title: CAS Application MCP Tool Tests
test_specs.notes: 9 new MCP tools: list_vaults (2), get_vault_stats (3), verify_hash (2), list_staging_edges (2), sage_confirm/dismiss_staging_edge (3), list_pending_metadata (2), list_directory (4), bulk_ingest_document (4), cross-cutting conventions (3). search catalog mode (2). chain (2). Single-server topology, sync-with-progress for batch ingest.

test_specs.title: CAS Application Edge Inference Tests
test_specs.notes: Filename parser (12 tests: segment recognition, date/version/code detection, doc_type resolution via keyword_to_doc_type and code_to_doc_type), version_chain inference (8 tests: normalization, linear chain, grouping by title/project/doc_type, doc_type-mismatch isolation, existing vault documents, null version handling), filename_code_match inference (6 tests: workflow-to-content direction, workflow-to-workflow exclusion, cross-batch matching, multi-code edges), two-phase orchestration (6 tests: pre-ingest edge plan, post-ingest resolution, tier-based creation, failed ingestion handling), lifecycle side effects (9 tests: the supersede transition derived from the vault's lifecycle table in both halves, the pre-flight gate that drops an edge whose target's state forbids supersede, the already-superseded target that is linked without a write, and the batch-wide invariant that no supersedes edge outlives an unsuperseded target, and the distinct refusal reasons for a target that is absent versus one whose read failed). EI-033 covers infer_edges=False short-circuit.

test_specs.title: SAGE Ingestion Metadata Extraction Tests
test_specs.notes: CAS-ADR-015: metadata extraction is a SAGE-level capability. ME-001 through ME-009 cover filename parse population on direct ingest, caller-metadata precedence, filename-over-adapter title precedence (the Cowork case), adapter-title fallback when no filename pattern is configured, doc_type non-misc resolution, misc default preservation, markdown/docx uniformity, review_required controlling metadata_confirmed, and app-backend import-relocation regression.

test_specs.title: SAGE Ingestion UI-Layer Metadata Normalization Tests
test_specs.notes: CAS-ADR-016: SAGE normalizes UI-layer file metadata on ingest. UIN-001 (integration): BSD UF_HIDDEN chflag cleared on ingest -- the empirically observed Cowork vector. UIN-002 (unit): com.apple.FinderInfo invisible bit cleared by the sanitization helper (defensive path). UIN-003 (unit): non-invisibility FinderInfo bytes (type/creator codes, color labels) preserved. UIN-004 (resilience, cross-platform): plain file with no UI markers ingests without error. macOS-specific tests gated by pytest.mark.skipif(sys.platform != 'darwin').

test_specs.title: SAGE Chain Resolution Tests
test_specs.notes: CAS-ADR-017: chain-scoped edge resolution with anchor and retraction primitives. Seven sections: write-time invariant enforcement (CR-001 through CR-012, 12 tests); traverse honors policy + anchors (CR-013 through CR-022, 10 tests); retracts edge end-to-end (CR-023 through CR-028, 6 tests); merged_from + tombstoning (CR-029 through CR-036, 8 tests); resolution_path debug payload (CR-037 through CR-042, 6 tests); registry coverage and TBD handling (CR-043 through CR-045, 3 tests); transitive_target mirror policy (CR-046 through CR-053, 8 tests). Canonical worked example: Chain A a1..a8, Chain B b1..b4, covers edge anchored at a3/b2. CR-005 revised: transitive_source stores target_valid_from_version as null (null-means-not-applicable per the ADR), not auto-populated from target_id.

test_specs.title: BatchIngestService Tests
test_specs.notes: BatchIngestService extracted from duplicate batch ingest logic in sage/mcp_server.py (JSON delivery) and app/backend/router.py (SSE delivery). The service owns the three-phase pipeline; callers provide delivery glue. TEST-BIS-001 through TEST-BIS-019 across 7 sections: service interface (BIS-001/002), file descriptor normalization (BIS-003/004), Phase 1 edge plan construction (BIS-005..007), Phase 2 per-file ingestion (BIS-008..011), Phase 3 post-ingest edge execution (BIS-012/013), progress callbacks (BIS-014..017), caller integration (BIS-018/019).

test_specs.title: CAS Application Backend Cleanup Tests
test_specs.notes: Code hygiene and refactoring safety for app/backend modules after iterative development. Two sections: import hygiene (TEST-APP-CL-002..003 cover scan pathlib-only convention, router HTTPException at module level; CL-001 retired when app/backend/edge_inference.py was deleted); metadata conversion fidelity (TEST-APP-CL-004..006 cover ScanResult to response, response to file descriptor, full round-trip preservation of all ParsedMetadata fields).

test_specs.title: SAGE/MCP Cleanup Refactor Test Specification
test_specs.notes: Code cleanup pass identified during 2026-04-10 review. Covers EdgeResult type consistency in batch ingest summary (CLN-001), shared batch ingest logic and MCP server split (CLN-002/004/005), module-level imports in MCP server (CLN-003), unused schema fields marked deprecated (CLN-006), service method signature convention deferred (CLN-007), edge inference exception detail (CLN-008), type annotation on _passes_scope (CLN-009), graph traversal helper naming (CLN-011), ingestion service IngestResult dataclass return (CLN-012). test_specs.title: Vault Management Test Specifications
test_specs.notes: Three MCP tools (create_vault, get_vault_config, update_vault_config) and the REST force-gate refinement to PUT /sage_vaults/{vault_id}/config. Design decisions: no delete tool; single-shape create (the original two-mode design was collapsed to a single config-dict argument matching CreateVaultRequest after the MCP-OpenAPI conformance gate flagged the asymmetry; callers wanting sensible defaults obtain the scaffold separately -- in-process from VaultRegistryService.get_default_config(), off-process from the default-config read); echo-back on create; named-section update kwargs (the original `sections: dict` wrapper was replaced with one optional kwarg per top-level section to match UpdateVaultConfigRequest directly); full-section replacement (no partial-section merges); destructive-change gate requiring force=True; vault.id immutability regardless of force; REST parity via force=true query parameter. TEST-APP-MCP-030 / -031 / -033 / -034 cover create_vault (default-config dict, duplicate rejection, full-config, invalid config); MCP-035 covers get_vault_config; MCP-036..040 cover update_vault_config (preserves omitted sections, blocks destructive without force, force proceeds with warnings, vault.id rejected even with force, invalid section rejected); TEST-SAGE-VM-REST-001..003 cover REST endpoint parity for the force gate; TEST-SAGE-VM-REST-004 covers the default-config read that serves the creation scaffold. TEST-APP-MCP-032 (mixed-mode rejection) was removed as the convenience kwargs no longer exist, which is why the MCP-030..040 range is sparse and holds ten specs rather than eleven.

revision_history.summary: Initial manifest. Four test spec files covering tiers 1-3. Scaffolding: pyproject.toml, conftest.py, SchemaValidator helper.

SAGE tier 2 behavioral test specifications. 42 tests across 7 subsystems encoding 19 design decisions (document ID generation, concurrency model, lifecycle error semantics, ingestion duplicate detection, pipeline failure quarantine, retrieval fusion, graph deduplication, path security, retrieval health assertions). Cross-cutting boundary tests expanded from stub to 12 tests (6 specified, 6 stubs awaiting ROOT Harness decisions). Schema changes identified for formal substrate update.

SAGE adapter test specifications. 25 tests across 2 adapters: LanceDB ContentStore (17 tests covering initialization, indexing, removal, vector search, BM25 search, heading prefix retrieval, persistence, edge cases) and nomic-embed-text EmbeddingProvider (8 tests covering dimension, determinism, normalization, batch behavior, similarity, edge cases). Encodes 13 design decisions for production adapter implementations.

Qwen3 AbstractionProvider adapter test specifications. 8 tests (AD-026 through AD-033) covering initialization (eager model load, fail-fast), output shape (non-empty string, max_tokens bound), determinism, edge cases (short input, long input truncation), semantic quality smoke test, and error propagation. Encodes 8 design decisions for the production abstraction provider (Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 via MLX).

Source file provenance. 4 behavioral tests (BH-049 through BH-052) covering source_modified_at on new ingestion, force re-ingestion update, graph store round-trip, and created_at/source_modified_at distinction. 1 adapter test (AD-034) for markdown adapter st_mtime extraction. Formal Substrate updated to v1.2 (Document.source_modified_at added to OpenAPI spec).

CAS Application test specifications. 55 frontend UI behavior tests (TEST-APP-UI-001 through UI-055) covering all 6 views: navigation and vault selector, Dashboard, Ingest (4-step workflow), Metadata Review, Edge Review, Search, Document Detail, Graph Explorer. 30 backend tests (TEST-APP-BE-001 through BE-030) covering 6 new SAGE API endpoints (vault listing, vault statistics, hash-check, staging edges, pending metadata, pipeline status filter on discover) and 2 application backend endpoints (directory scan, batch ingest via SSE) plus conventions. Encodes design decisions for SSE event format, scan depth control, hash algorithm alignment, per-file error isolation, and endpoint URL prefix separation.

CAS Application MCP tool test specifications. 25 tests (TEST-APP-MCP-001 through MCP-025) covering 9 new MCP tools added to sage/mcp_server.py: list_vaults (2 tests), get_vault_stats (3 tests), verify_hash (2 tests), list_staging_edges (2 tests), sage_confirm/dismiss_staging_edge (3 tests), list_pending_metadata (2 tests), list_directory (4 tests), bulk_ingest_document (4 tests), cross-cutting conventions (3 tests). Encodes design decisions for single-server topology (SAGE + app tools share vault registry), synchronous batch ingest with MCP progress notifications, and naming prefix convention (sage_* vs app_*).

Edge inference and revised app backend test specifications. New file: tests/app/edge_inference_tests.md with 30 tests (TEST-APP-EI-001 through EI-030) across 5 sections: filename parser segment recognition (8 tests), doc_type resolution (4 tests), version_chain inference (6 tests), filename_code_match inference (6 tests), two-phase orchestration (6 tests). Encodes design decisions for tolerant filename parser (all segments nullable except title, known_code_patterns from vault config, keyword_to_doc_type precedence over code_to_doc_type), linear version chains (immediate predecessor only), directed workflow-to-content code matching, and pre-ingest/post-ingest edge plan separation. Backend tests revised: TEST-APP-BE-018 updated for parsed_metadata in scan results, TEST-APP-BE-025 updated for metadata dict in SAGE ingest calls, 3 new tests (BE-031 through BE-033) for edge inference integration in batch ingest, convention tests renumbered to BE-034/BE-035. Backend test count: 30 -> 35.

Document date metadata test specifications. 4 behavioral tests (BH-062 through BH-065) covering document_date from filename metadata, source_modified_at fallback, null when neither available, and graph store round-trip. 1 backend test (BE-036) for document_date in pending metadata extracted_fields. Schema change: Document.document_date nullable string (YYYY-MM-DD). Behavioral test count: 52 -> 56. Backend test count: 35 -> 36.

Sequential pipeline and lazy MLX loading. BH-026 revised from async background pipeline to sequential in-process pipeline (Stages 1-3 complete before ingest returns). AD-026 revised from eager model loading to lazy loading on first generate_abstract() call. 1 new behavioral test (BH-068: sequential pipeline sets final status before returning). 3 new adapter tests (AD-035: lazy load defers to first call, AD-036: second call reuses model, AD-037: load failure raises RuntimeError). Behavioral test count: 56 -> 57. Adapter test count: 34 -> 37.

Document-level response mode test specifications. 5 new behavioral tests (BH-084 through BH-088) covering response_level parameter on search: semantic search with documents mode omits chunk content, keyword search with documents mode omits chunk content, documents mode preserves relevance scores and ordering, chunks default preserves current behavior, response_level ignored by catalog mode. Behavioral test count: 78 -> 83.

Chain walk and edge-type breakdown test specifications. 8 new behavioral tests (BH-089 through BH-096) for chain: linear chain ordered result, entry-point invariance (head/tail/middle), single-node chain, fork detection (is_linear flag), edge-type isolation, 404 on missing document, non-supersedes edge types. 4 new behavioral tests (BH-097 through BH-100) for TraversalNode.edge_counts: mixed-type counts map, single-key map, filtered traversal restricts counts, multi-depth per-node independence. BH-037 revised: edge_count replaced by edge_counts map (breaking change). 2 new MCP tests (MCP-028, MCP-029) for chain tool. Behavioral test count: 83 -> 95. MCP tool test count: 27 -> 29.

Semantic abstract consumer test specifications (CAS-ADR-011). Phase 1: 4 new behavioral tests (BH-101 through BH-104) verifying semantic_abstract surfacing on DocumentSummary across semantic, catalog, and document-level response modes. Phase 2: 7 new behavioral tests (BH-105 through BH-111) for two-pass abstract-boosted retrieval: abstract match boost, graceful degradation for abstractless documents, scope gating, opt-out via use_abstract_prefilter, keyword mode integration, hybrid RRF composition, and salience reranking stacking. Behavioral test count: 95 -> 106.

SAGE ingestion metadata extraction test specifications (CAS-ADR-015). New file tests/sage/metadata_extraction_tests.md with 9 tests (ME-001 through ME-009) validating that IngestionService invokes FilenameParser on every ingest using the vault's metadata_extraction config. Covers filename parse population on direct ingest, caller-metadata precedence over filename parse, filename-over-adapter title precedence (the Cowork case), adapter-title fallback when no filename pattern is configured, doc_type resolution without misc-clobbering, misc default preservation when parse yields nothing, markdown/docx adapter uniformity, review_required flag controlling metadata_confirmed at ingest, and app-backend import-relocation regression (FilenameParser moved from app/backend/ to sage/services/). One test update: tests/app/test_mcp_app_tools.py::test_mcp_013_returns_pending now uses a review_required=true vault to legitimately produce pending-metadata items.

SAGE ingestion UI-layer metadata normalization test specifications (CAS-ADR-016). New file tests/sage/ingestion_ui_normalization_tests.md with 4 tests (UIN-001 through UIN-004). UIN-001 (integration, macOS-only) ingests a file with BSD UF_HIDDEN set and verifies the vault copy does not inherit it -- the real-world Cowork vector observed when an agent flags its working temp file invisible. UIN-002 and UIN-003 (unit tests, macOS-only) exercise the sanitization helper on com.apple.FinderInfo: invisible bit cleared, all other bytes (type/creator codes, color labels) preserved. UIN-004 (cross-platform resilience) verifies that plain files with no UI markers ingest without disturbance. Implementation uses ctypes to call libc getxattr/setxattr/removexattr on macOS (Python stdlib's xattr API is Linux-only). No new third-party dependency.

Transactional supersede. 2 new behavioral tests (BH-135, BH-136) in tests/sage/test_supersede_atomicity.py. BH-135: lifecycle.set_lifecycle's supersede branch now wraps the predecessor lifecycle flip and the supersedes-edge insert in a single SQLite transaction via the new GraphStore.supersede_atomic primitive; an injected mid-transaction failure leaves the predecessor active rather than archived-without-edge. BH-136: ingest's new-document branch wraps the doc insert + predecessor flip + edge insert in a single transaction via the new GraphStore.insert_with_supersede_atomic primitive (LifecycleService.prepare_supersede produces the validated transition without writing); an injected mid-transaction failure leaves no orphan successor record. The orphan class Cowork observed with PV02 (successor record exists, predecessor still active, no supersedes edge) is closed by construction. The PV02 orphan itself will be repaired by a one-time surgical fix rather than a permanent repair API. Behavioral test count: 134 -> 136.

Chain-scoped edge resolution test specifications (CAS-ADR-017, Chunk 1). New file tests/sage/chain_resolution_tests.md with 45 tier-2 behavioral tests (TEST-SAGE-CR-001 through CR-045) across six sections: write-time invariant enforcement by resolution_policy (12 tests), traverse honoring policy and anchor-in-lineage filtering (10 tests), retracts edge end-to-end (6 tests), merged_from + tombstoning (8 tests), resolution_path debug payload (6 tests), and registry coverage / TBD handling (3 tests). Canonical worked example: Chain A (a1..a8), Chain B (b1..b4), covers edge anchored at a3/b2. Encodes the frozen 11-row resolution_policy registry: supersedes/retracts/merged_from=none, derived_from=transitive_source, covers/references/bundles_with/depends_on/instantiated_from=transitive_both, authoritative_for/sync_target=TBD. tests/sage/contract_tests.md extended: new edge_type_registry.schema.json section (TEST-SAGE-ER-001 through ER-006, 6 tests) validates the new registry schema; new TEST-SAGE-API-005 through API-010 (6 tests) verify the extended EdgeType enum, the new ResolutionPolicy enum, Edge anchor-field shape, LinkRequest shape, TraverseRequest.debug, and TraverseResponse.resolution_path / ResolutionPathEntry. Contract test count: 53 -> 65.

CAS-ADR-017 conformance: align code to ADR on two prior deviations. (1) transitive_target added to the ResolutionPolicy enum (previously missing; ADR mandates four-value enumeration). New Section 7 in tests/sage/chain_resolution_tests.md: 8 tier-2 tests (CR-046 through CR-053) cover the mirror policy end-to-end: write-time invariant (target anchor required, source anchor forbidden, target anchor must be in target lineage), traversal semantics (source frozen at derivation - no seed expansion; target chain advances - seed expands to target lineage), and retracts-suppression applicability. (2) transitive_source stored representation: target_valid_from_version is null on the row (ADR's null-means-not-applicable), not auto-populated from target_id. CR-005 revised to assert null. Contract test enum constraints updated at tests/sage/contract_tests.md TEST-SAGE-ER-003 and TEST-SAGE-API-006 to include transitive_target. Chain resolution test count: 45 -> 53.

Adapter spec/code drift remediation. Backfilled 33 missing source-adapter specs in tests/sage/adapter_tests.md to match pytest test cases that had been delivered without corresponding markdown specs: Docx source adapter (18 tests, AD-035..AD-052) and Xlsx source adapter (15 tests, AD-053..AD-067). Resolved an AD-numbering collision in tests/sage/test_adapters.py: the Qwen3 lazy-loading tests (AD-035..AD-037 in spec) and the docx pytest tests (AD-035..AD-037 by docstring) had collided since 2026-04-11. Renumbered the Qwen3 lazy-loading section (spec and pytest) from AD-035..AD-037 to AD-095..AD-097 to densely pack the source-adapter range AD-035..AD-094 (docx + xlsx + dotx + PDF). Spec section structure: Section 5 Docx Source Adapter (NEW), Section 6 Xlsx Source Adapter (NEW), Section 7 Docx Adapter -- Template (.dotx) Support (was Section 6), Section 8 PDF Source Adapter (unchanged), Section 9 Qwen3 AbstractionProvider -- Lazy Loading (relocated from Section 5). AD-068..AD-075 (dotx) and AD-076..AD-094 (PDF) unchanged. AD numbering is now contiguous AD-001..AD-097. Adapter test count: 64 -> 97 (33 backfilled, 0 added or removed in pytest).

LanceDB has_chunks existence-check spec backfill and AD-068/AD-069 cross-class collision resolution. The has_chunks tests on TestLanceDBContentStore (delivered in v0.9.9, 2026-04-15, as the lightweight existence probe supporting recompute_abstract's fast-ack synchronous prefix) docstring as AD-068/AD-069 in tests/sage/test_adapters.py, but those AD numbers were also claimed in v0.9.10 (2026-04-17) for the dotx adapter spec (Section 7 of adapter_tests.md). The dotx specs are formally registered and frozen. Resolution: renumbered the two has_chunks pytest method names and docstrings from AD-068/AD-069 to AD-098/AD-099, and added a new Section 10 (LanceDB ContentStore -- has_chunks Existence Check) to tests/sage/adapter_tests.md with the two backfilled specs. AD-068..AD-075 (dotx, frozen) unchanged. AD numbering is now contiguous AD-001..AD-099. Adapter test count: 97 -> 99 (2 backfilled specs; pytest method count unchanged).

Manifest reconciliation and BH backfill. Audited every test_count field against unique test IDs in the source spec files and found four drifted entries. Three were corrected as manifest-only edits: tests/app/frontend_tests.md 55 -> 56 (UI-056 added without a manifest bump); tests/app/backend_tests.md 36 -> 34 (the 029/030 -> 034/035 renumbering left a 2-slot ID gap that was never reflected in the count); tests/app/edge_inference_tests.md 30 -> 34 (EI-031, EI-032, EI-033 added during lifecycle side-effects and infer_edges=False work, plus EI-015b for version_chain doc_type tightening). The fourth, tests/sage/behavioral_tests.md, was investigated and found to have nine BH IDs implemented in pytest but never specified in markdown: BH-053..057 (external file imports, originating commit 5cd10d8 on 2026-04-06) and BH-080..083 (catalog sort, delivered 2026-04-13 per tracker v0.9.4). Specifications were backfilled from the pytest implementations into two new sections of behavioral_tests.md: Section 10 'External Source Imports' (between Section 9 and Schema Changes Required) and 'Catalog Sort' (between the catalog combined-filters section and Document-Level Response Mode). Behavioral test count restored to 136 with contiguous BH-001..BH-136 numbering. Notes for backend_tests.md and edge_inference_tests.md updated to reflect current section composition.

Spec-file registry reconciliation. Audit of tests/ vs the manifest found six spec markdown files on disk that were not registered. One, tests/sage/ingestion_dedup_tests.md, was a single-test redundant copy of TEST-SAGE-BH-071 already specified in tests/sage/behavioral_tests.md; the standalone file additionally described an outdated force=True-based test path that no longer matches the pytest implementation. Resolution: deleted the redundant file (no test coverage lost). The remaining five files were registered as new test_specs entries: tests/app/batch_ingest_service_tests.md (19 tests, BIS-001..019, covers the shared three-phase batch ingest pipeline); tests/app/cleanup_tests.md (6 tests, APP-CL-001..006, covers app/backend module hygiene); tests/sage/migrate_flag_tests.md (13 tests, MIG-001..013, covers --migrate CLI gating for SQLite and LanceDB migrations); tests/sage/test_cleanup_refactor.md (9 tests, sparse CLN-001..012, covers SAGE/MCP cleanup pass from the 2026-04-10 review); tests/sage/vault_management_tests.md (14 tests, MCP-030..040 + SAGE-VM-REST-001..003, covers vault-management MCP tools and REST force-gate parity). +61 tests across the manifest. test_cleanup_refactor.md uses the test_*.md prefix rather than the *_tests.md convention used elsewhere; flagged but not renamed in this sweep.

Lifecycle side-effects section rewritten in tests/app/edge_inference_tests.md for the table-derived supersede transition. EI-031 and EI-032 previously specified the transition with the state literals "active" and "archived"; EI-032 in particular specified that a non-active target has its lifecycle update skipped while the supersedes edge is created anyway, which left a successor edge pointing at a predecessor that was never transitioned. Both were rewritten against the vault's lifecycle transition table, and EI-032's disposition changed from skip-the-update to drop-the-edge-and-warn. Six new specifications were added for the properties that distinguish a table-derived implementation from a hardcoded one, which coincide under the base lifecycle: EI-034 (landing state read from the table), EI-035 (supersede permitted from any state the table declares), EI-036 (batch-wide invariant, asserted over the targets actually linked), EI-037 (absent target), EI-038 (already-superseded target linked without a write -- the chain-repair case), and EI-039 (landing-state recognition itself table-derived). Edge inference test count: 34 -> 40. The new ids start at EI-034 because EI-033 was already allocated to the infer_edges=False short-circuit.

Review follow-up on the table-derived supersede transition. EI-037's expected warning reason changed from supersede_target_not_transitionable to supersede_target_missing, and EI-040 was added for supersede_target_read_failed: one reason had been carrying three conditions that leave the graph in different states (no edge because the target's state forbids supersede, no edge because the target does not exist, and no edge because the read raised), which a caller triaging warnings cannot separate. Edge inference test count: 40 -> 41. Not specified here: TEST-BIS-CR-005, which pins that a chain repair whose replacement add is refused withholds its removals rather than severing the chain -- the chain-repair tests CR-001..005 live in pytest without markdown specifications, a pre-existing gap this change did not widen.

Retired TEST-SAGE-API-002 in tests/sage/contract_tests.md, which asserted an exhaustive hand-maintained list of fourteen path/method pairs against a spec that now declares forty-three operations, two of the listed shapes having been collapsed by the CAS-ADR-029 plural-noun rename. The section keeps its id as a RETIRED stub and names tests/sage/test_openapi_conformance.py::test_spec_covers_all_app_operations as the surface that carries operation coverage in both directions with SPEC_FORWARD_DECLARATIONS as the only allowlist; an exhaustive enumeration of the surface no longer lives in markdown. The whole-file sweep restated three more claims that the spec had outgrown: API-003 now asserts that delete is declared only on the edge-unlink path (the single DELETE, on edges/{edge_id}, is outside the no-delete invariant, which covers documents only); API-004 enumerates the three paths outside /sage_vaults/{vault_id}/ (the vault collection and the two process-scoped transfer endpoints); API-007 records resolution_policy as nullable and absent from Edge.required, matching the spec. Contract test count corrected: 59 -> 62, counted as live specifications with the RETIRED stub excluded (the file carried 63 headings against a recorded 59 before this change). API-003 and API-004 each name a pytest gate added alongside them in tests/sage/test_openapi_conformance.py (test_delete_is_declared_only_on_the_edge_unlink_path; test_only_the_vault_collection_and_transfer_paths_sit_outside_vault_scope, with a teeth test over a violating spec), so neither invariant is markdown-only. The spec's own header comment, which made the same every-endpoint-is-vault-scoped claim, now states the three exceptions. tests/root_harness/contract_tests.md TEST-RH-API-002 rewritten from an exhaustive claim (exactly these nine pairs) to a coverage claim (each Section 2.5 operation exists; operations beyond the table are not a failure), since ROOT Harness has no implementation and therefore no mechanical gate to retire it toward. ROOT Harness contract test count unchanged.
